This '''Rebel sympathizer''' was a pink-skinned [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] captured by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]. A bounty was placed on her head as she was believed to have information that could aid in [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] search for [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].
